reason: A settings management plugin that provides form-based settings browsing and editing, guarded YAML configuration file operations, and an SDK for registering plugin settings namespaces.

summaries.zh: 用于浏览和编辑注册设置及插件配置的管理插件，支持表单与受限配置文件操作，并提供设置命名空间注册 SDK。
summaries.en: A settings management plugin for browsing and editing registered settings and plugin configurations through forms or constrained configuration files, with an SDK for registering settings namespaces.

capabilities: Enumerates registered settings namespaces and plugin composition configurations
Reads and writes allowlisted YAML configuration files
Registers plugin-owned settings namespaces through an SDK
